description: A grand double-height staircase foyer with a contemporary luxury hotel aesthetic. A sweeping open-tread staircase in glossy dark espresso-lacquered wood or stone rises in a wide L-shaped spiral from the lower level upward to the right. The stair railing and newel cap are in the same deep dark finish, razor-thin in profile. The surrounding walls are clad in large-format natural stone tiles in warm greige tones — likely travertine or limestone — with subtle horizontal veining and a matte honed surface. The high double-height ceiling is white plaster. A slender upper-level window at the top right floods the upper zone with cool natural daylight. A partial decorative wall panel in matte dark bronze or black with a geometric angular form anchors the lower left corner. Suspended through the double-height void above the stairwell, a series of alabaster or frosted marble cylinders in brass fittings hang at dramatically varied lengths from a single overhead canopy, forming a cascading vertical array that follows the helical sweep of the staircase. Each cylinder emits a warm amber glow that reflects softly off the polished stone walls. Camera at a slightly elevated angle looking down into the stairwell from an upper-landing vantage point, three-quarter corner composition, normal to wide lens, slight downward pitch, full establishing staircase view.
